title: WhatsApp bridge
subtitle: Link this country’s Customer Care phone. The QR is not shown on the operator inbox.
waiting: Waiting for a QR from the bridge.
steps: On the Customer Care phone: WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan this code. WhatsApp rotates it about every 60 seconds.
pairingHelp: On the phone choose Link with phone number instead, and enter this code immediately.
pickCountry: Choose Lesotho, Benin, or Zambia in the sidebar. This page talks to that lane’s API only.
notConfigured: This country has no bridge URL. The page does not fall back to another country’s bridge.
sop: Setup steps are in the Customer Care WhatsApp SOP.
unreachable: The bridge URL is set, but the link status could not be read.
